title: Nasty Winey Quinoa Pilaf
description: This quick-fix Slovakian dish features al-dente quinoa infused with a touch of wine and dark soft brown sugar for a savory-sweet taste.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water and drain.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onions and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic cloves and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in rinsed quinoa and toast for about 1 minute to coat with oil and develop flavor.
Pour in white wine and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 8 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Add dark soft brown sugar and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for an additional 2-3 minutes or until quinoa is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Remove from heat, stir in chopped parsley, and serve hot.
